Directional sight: selected initial contrast and information rules

Three design mockups on the current urban map, using existing Survivor/Walker/Runner/Sprinter art. Clear 110 degrees, peripheral coverage to 150 degrees, nearby awareness 24 units. Values come from the canonical design brief, not new runtime configuration. These are static authored observation assignments, not a second visibility engine or gameplay acceptance.

Remembered terrain is desaturated/dim. Unknown details are opaque. Lost creatures fade at their last observed position. A hidden broken crate still uses its intact remembered appearance. Magenta corner outlines are proposed diagnostic geometry without wall artwork; they are not existing blockers or a playable map change.

No scene below is a new executable capture. Ground is an inherited map render with 4800 current visual GIDs and authored dependencies checked; actor quads reuse accepted native metadata. No approach audio has been added or listening-approved. Runtime LOS, partial cover, unseen updates, 128-actor performance and human fairness require separate evidence.
